# `<e-collapse>`

<!-- No screenshot found. Run the screenshots test to generate one. -->

Stack of expandable sections built on native `<details>`/`<summary>`.

Reads its panels from child `<e-collapse-panel>` elements at connect time.
Expanding a section mutates one `open` attribute, so the EPDC repaints only
the section that changed instead of reflowing the page — which is what makes
a collapse a better fit than a scrolling wall of text on e-paper.

Disclosure state lives on the native element, so keyboard support, the
accessible name and find-in-page all come from the browser.

> Source: [collapse.ts](./collapse.ts)

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accordion` | `boolean` | — | Allows only one open panel at a time; opening one closes the rest. |
| `default-open` | `string` | — | Comma-separated panel keys open on first render. A panel's own `open` attribute has the same effect. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `e-change` | `CustomEvent<{value: string[]}>` | Fired when a panel opens or closes. `value` lists the keys of every open panel, in document order. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _(default)_ | Default slot for `<e-collapse-panel>` children. |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Read-only | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string[]` | no | Open exactly the given keys, closing every other panel. Emits nothing. |
